body.text: Vaughn Law has established a solid track record with Saint Petersburg new construction builders. Whether it’s new construction or a remodel, we have the tools to keep your sales on schedule.

We are available to answer questions and provide guidance as you get started building your first home. We can assist you with your first contract and we can personalize a new construction sales contract so you can sell your pre-build homes!
We also offer guidance on the several options for liability protection.
[Learn more](https://dvaughnlaw.com/vaughnlaw/contact/) about how new and existing builders can benefit from working with Vaughn Law.
